page.layout: One page of text, no margin notes. Running head with page number at top. Continuous text, then a decorative ornament, a chapter heading with subtitle, and a passage beginning with a woodcut initial. Signature at the foot right.

main_text.p: to Genefeos libro tradit Mofcs. Vnde aduerfus huiufmodi allegoriftas, & facrae Scripturae corruptores fcripfit libr. 12. De Genefi ad literam Auguftinus. Denique infinitum effet, quanta fit vbique huius authoris impuritas colligere, quae Bernardus perftrinxit tum Homilia de Dicto Origen. tum Sermo. 54. in Cantat. Cant. quem tamen tanquam oculos fuos quidam diligunt: quum & de peccato Originis, & de Purgatorio peffime fenferit, magnaque errorum qui post-ea funt confecuti, femina fparferit: tanti eft ad fobrietatem fapere, neque vanis animi fui commentis more [illegible, ~8 letters] indulgere, quod fecit Origenes.
3 In libris de Ciuitate Dei.) Vide librum 20. De ciuitate, cap. 7. & 9. item libr. 21. cap. 23. item etiam eiusdem operis libr. 22. & Tertullianum in libr. De anima. & saepe Basilium in Homiliis.
main_text.head: CAP. XLIIII.
Pauliani, vel Samosateniani cur sic dicti. Erroris autem eorum capita duo declarantur.

p.i: Auliani{1} à Paulo Samosateno, Christum{2} non semper fuisse dicunt, sed eius initium, ex quo de Maria natus est, asseuerant, nec eum aliquid amplius, quàm hominem putant. Ista haeresis aliquando cuiusdam Artemonis fuit: sed quum defecisset, instaurata est à Paulo: &

page.notes: Ornamental woodcut initial "A" before "Auliani" and decorative border above CAP. XLIIII. Superscript marks {1} and {2} in the passage have no corresponding notes on this page. The Greek word in line 6 is smudged and could not be read. "Mofcs" is printed with a final c-like letter and may be a misprint for "Moses". The "3" paragraph is set inside the text column, so it is treated as running text.
